title: Crocodylomorphs and Birds

conceptScope.en: Twelve primary-evidence dossiers compare crocodile-line and bird-line archosaurs without merging their histories. The four existing profiles—Archaeopteryx, Neornithes, Carnufex and Asteriornis—remain linked to their claims and source-bounded ranges; six bilingual species pages add Carnufex carolinensis, Asteriornis maastrichtensis and four dinosaurs. The species pages link displayed fields to claims while withholding unsupported global first and last appearances. Eight curated navigation nodes support discovery without asserting direct ancestry or global first appearances. COL26.8 still routes exactly 11,071 strictly accepted living species names into the package as nomenclatural browse coverage.
conceptScope.zh: 十二个一手证据档案比较鳄类支系与鸟类支系主龙而不混并其历史。始祖鸟、今鸟类、Carnufex 与 Asteriornis 四份既有档案继续关联各自主张和来源限定延限；新增六篇双语种级页，包括 Carnufex carolinensis、Asteriornis maastrichtensis 和四种恐龙。种级页将显示字段连接到主张，并对证据不足的全球首现与末现明确留空。八个策展导航节点服务于发现，不表示直系祖先或全球首现。COL26.8 仍把恰好 11,071 个严格接受的现生种名路由到本包，作为命名浏览覆盖。

limitations: Package dossiers expose the current curated evidence boundary; unavailable fields are explicit and are not inferred.
